comment: Package kit hints for Warehouse (docs/package-testing.md «Module kit file»). Warehouse requires Approvals (a core service) and links to Procurement (receipts from purchase requests: the picker, a receipt draft made from a request, delivery marks through Procurement's public API), Masterplan (issues to projects and objects through the core «objects» source; names of issued-to objects while Masterplan's tables exist) and Counterparties. Procurement and Masterplan are installed as linked packages; on the upgrade source (main) Masterplan is already a package and Procurement is built in. The seed makes a receipt draft from an approved demo purchase request through the API. «Everyone sees stock» is switched off by the seed, so the plain user's answers are filtered (on by default: every signed-in person sees stock without sums).

apiParams.id: SELECT id FROM wh_docs ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.procDoc: SELECT id FROM wh_docs WHERE proc_request_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.projectId: SELECT project_id FROM wh_warehouses WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.objectReserve: SELECT target_id FROM wh_reserves WHERE target_type = 'object' AND target_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.approvalDoc: SELECT doc_id FROM approval_processes WHERE type = 'warehouse.document' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

pageParams.id: SELECT id FROM wh_docs ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

links.name: Warehouse → Procurement: requests waiting for goods (receipt picker)
Warehouse ↔ Procurement: a receipt made from a purchase request
Procurement ← Warehouse: the request of that receipt
Warehouse → materials by a Masterplan project (its objects included)
Warehouse → reserves under a Masterplan object
Approvals → the route of the document type warehouse.document
Approvals → the approval of a demo write-off
dashboard widgets (below minimum, incoming, my tools)

openToUsersWhy.meta: settings the forms need (currencies, units, prefixes, thresholds) and the warehouses the person sees (filtered: none for the plain user); the longest list is the units
openToUsersWhy.people: people picker (recipients, MOL, counters: names and avatars of active users, as elsewhere in the portal)
openToUsersWhy.groups: group picker of the zones-of-responsibility editor (group names, as in the roles editor)
openToUsersWhy.categories: the item category tree (names, no stock)
openToUsersWhy.stock/hints: line hints of a document form; empty without item ids, and only for warehouses the person sees
openToUsersWhy.documents/counters: chip counters of the documents the person may see (numbers only)
